simple.meaning: מַתָּנָה (Mattânâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Mattanah , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַתָּנָה (H4980) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 21:18, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַתָּנָה (H4980) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַתָּנָה (H4980) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַתָּנָה (Mattânâh) / H4980 is traced through Numbers 21:18, Numbers 21:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
